description: This header file declares exported API functions related to the TLS Cipher Switch Object, including creation and initialization functions, for a Transport Layer Security implementation within an embedded system or software stack.

methods.name: TlsCreateCipherSwitch
methods.description: Creates a new TLS cipher switch object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: TlsCsoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new TLS cipher switch object with specified context and handles.

methods.name: TlsCsoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the TLS cipher switch object.
